title: Remove icons from target buttons
description: Remove icon components from the identified button instances to achieve a cleaner look
details: Remove the icon components (e.g., Lucide React icons like ChevronRight, ArrowRight, etc.) from the button JSX in the identified files. This involves deleting the icon import statements if they're no longer used and removing the icon component from within the Button component. Ensure proper spacing is maintained after icon removal by adjusting any margin or padding classes if necessary.
test_strategy: Visual testing to confirm icons are removed and buttons maintain proper spacing and alignment. Test in both light and dark themes to ensure consistency.

title: Identify and locate target button instances
description: Locate the specific button(s) that need improvement and icon removal across the application
details: Examine key pages (app/page.tsx, app/sign-in/page.tsx, app/sign-up/page.tsx) to identify the button instances that contain icons and need visual improvement. Document the current implementation including which icons are being used (likely Lucide React icons), current variant/size props, and the button's context within each page. This will establish a clear baseline for the improvements.
test_strategy: Manual inspection of each page in the browser to identify buttons with icons. Take screenshots of current state for comparison after changes.

title: Enhance button visual styling and prominence
description: Improve the visual appearance of buttons by adjusting variant, size, or adding new styling options
details: Enhance the button's visual prominence by modifying props such as changing from 'secondary' to 'default' variant, increasing size to 'lg', or adjusting font weight. If existing variants don't meet requirements, add a new variant to the buttonVariants object in components/ui/button.tsx using class-variance-authority. Focus on making the buttons more prominent and visually appealing while maintaining consistency with the design system and ensuring accessibility standards (color contrast, focus states).
test_strategy: Cross-browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) to verify visual improvements. Test all button states (default, hover, focus, disabled) and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for color contrast. Use preview deployment for stakeholder review.
